rules.expectation: Factory and after-receipt routes each preserve four original windows; a genuine failed inspection and formally arranged rewash additionally prove four work nodes/eight projections/six unique native identities, all separately selectable and returnable. Scope selection compares complete evidence sets, not a template count; explicit invalid targets do not fall back, while deliberate user range selection clears the cached and URL window focus, including a status change that retains the same node. Implicitly selected work binds both node and window in the initial link and selection/return context even when rewash evidence appears in two instances. Real App clicks every window, exact native event/date matching and budget second-hop/return preserve original node/scope/filter/material focus. Read views hide/disable forms and refuse submit without gaining capabilities; foreign/ambiguous/unavailable refs stay explicit. Same mounted original draft/pending immutable key/body survive same-order failed read or cancelled navigation. True browser reload durability belongs to approved E and is not claimed.
